name: Red Carpet Diaries
source:
The series revolves around a young woman who recently moved to Los Angeles from Iowa to start her career as an actress. 

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Red_Carpet_Diaries]Choices Wikia[/url]]

本系列圍繞一位年輕女子展開，她剛從愛荷華州搬到洛杉磯，準備開啟自己的演員生涯。
